title: test_vector_file_schema manifest covers only 21 of ~180 corpora
description: python/tests/test_vectors.py test_vector_file_schema validates only the 21 explicitly listed filenames against test/vectors/schema.json, but test/vectors/ holds ~180 corpus JSONs (203 json minus schemas); new corpus files silently skip generic schema validation unless a worker remembers the manifest (the forward gate just proved its value by catching the phantom density_adaptive.json entry, project-LICHEN-worker6-1p2r.6). Fix: derive the parametrize from the directory listing (test/vectors/*.json minus *.schema.json, schema.json, and an explicit exemption list for non-envelope files), or add a companion test asserting every corpus file is manifest-listed. Watch for suites like ccp16-desync.json (bare array root) that need the schema's per-family branches or exemption. Discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-1p2r.6 codereview pass 3 (edge cases).
